definitions.de: Treten; etwas oder jemanden mit dem Fuß schlagen, besonders einen Ball im Sport
definitions.en: To kick; to strike something or someone with the foot, especially a ball in sports
definitions.es: Patear; golpear algo o a alguien con el pie, especialmente una pelota en deportes
definitions.fr: Donner un coup de pied; frapper quelque chose ou quelqu'un avec le pied, surtout un ballon dans les sports
definitions.hi: लात मारना; पैर से किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति को मारना, विशेषकर खेलों में गेंद को
definitions.ja: 蹴る；足で何かや誰かを蹴ること、特にスポーツでボールを蹴ること
definitions.km: បោះជើង; ប្រើជើងទាត់អ្វីមួយ ឬនរណាម្នាក់ ជាពិសេសបាល់ក្នុងកីឡា
definitions.ko: 차다; 발로 무언가나 누군가를 치다, 특히 스포츠에서 공을 차다
definitions.ne: लात हान्नु; खुट्टाले केही वा कसैलाई हान्नु, विशेष गरी खेलकुदमा बललाई
definitions.pt: Chutar; golpear algo ou alguém com o pé, especialmente uma bola em esportes
definitions.th: เตะ; การใช้เท้าต่อยหรือตีบางอย่างหรือบางคน โดยเฉพาะลูกบอลในกีฬา
definitions.tl: Sipain; ang tamaan ng paa ang isang bagay o tao, lalo na ang bola sa palakasan
definitions.ur: لات مارنا؛ پاؤں سے کسی چیز یا شخص کو مارنا، خاص طور پر کھیلوں میں گیند کو
definitions.vi: Đá; dùng chân đánh vào vật gì hoặc ai đó, đặc biệt là quả bóng trong thể thao
definitions.zh: 踢；用脚踢某物或某人，尤其是在运动中踢球
definitions.zh_Hant: 踢；用腳踢某物或某人，尤其是在運動中踢球

definition_en: To kick; to strike something or someone with the foot, especially a ball in sports

lao_examples.lao_script: ເຕະບານໃຫ້ຂ້ອຍແດ່ ຂ້ອຍຈະຂວ້າງຄືນ
lao_examples.romanization: Te ban hai khoi dae, khoi ja khwang khuun.
lao_examples.translation_en: Kick the ball to me, I'll throw it back.

lao_examples.lao_script: ນັກກິລາຄົນນັ້ນເຕະໄດ້ແຮງຫຼາຍ
lao_examples.romanization: Nak-ki-la khon nan te dai haeng lai.
lao_examples.translation_en: That athlete can kick really hard.
